requiredFindings.title: The chain counter wraps despite the accepted never-reused identity requirement
requiredFindings.description: NEXT_CHAIN.fetch_add(1, Relaxed) wraps modulo 2^64. After exhaustion it can mint an identity already associated with a retained chain/observation, so NoRepository::retained can no longer establish its promised exact-chain binding. A3 requires a never-reused identity, and its acceptance explicitly requires that the counter cannot wrap or reset into reuse. LD-1 replaces that invariant with an operational infeasibility assumption. Exhaustion is extraordinarily remote, but the implementation does not meet the unconditional identity contract.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Prevent issuance after identity-space exhaustion, using a checked/non-wrapping allocator that fails closed before reuse. This need not add a public chain refusal code: an internal fail-stop at the unreachable boundary can preserve all ordinary 6a behavior. Add a deterministic allocator-boundary control using a local/test counter near its maximum, without performing 2^64 walks or resetting the live global counter; refresh affected pins and evidence.
